messages:
maria: Quick design sync — proposing a 'structured lane' for each tool call in Playground run history. Visual: vertical cards, header (fn name + schema tag), collapse, and per-lane quick actions (copy, open schema, raw JSON). Need copy + a11y review. sam: Love the cards. Two UX asks: 1) collapsed summary needs one-line clarity, 2) show status (ok/error/streaming) in the header. alex: Keyboard behavior is critical. Left/Right should move between lanes, Up/Down inside a lane to traverse outputs. Also each header action must be reachable by Tab order. zoe: Copy ideas: instead of 'Output' use 'Result' or 'Tool result'. In collapsed state show "Result: {short summary}". Keep header under 28 chars for translations. maria: Good call. For header copy options: 'fetch_user() · 190ms', 'fetch_user() — Result', or 'fetch_user() (structured)'. Which reads better? sam: First one (with time) is compact and useful. Add a small pill for type: [Structured] vs [Text]. dinesh: Accessibility: use button for collapse with aria-expanded and aria-controls. The lane panel should be a role=region with aria-labelledby pointing to the header. For streaming, set aria-live="polite" but only announce finalization message to avoid noise. alex: Also trap focus when the lane is open and a modal or inspector is launched. Focus order: header → actions → output → nested schema controls. Unit tests should assert focus sequence. zoe: Nit: ensure copy-to-clipboard announces success to SRs: "JSON copied to clipboard" and visually show a transient tooltip. maria: Behavior question: when streaming, do we append lines or replace? I'm leaning append with subtle fade-in. But need to avoid auto-scroll if user selection/focus is inside. sam: Append is fine. Implement auto-scroll only when the user hasn't interacted; otherwise show a small "new" badge at lane bottom. alex: For drill-in to nested objects, add keyboard-friendly breadcrumbs in the lane header area. Right arrow drills in, left arrow up a level. Breadcrumbs must be accessible and announce current path. dinesh: Suggest adding an export action to copy selected schema path as JSON schema snippet. Make it reachable via keyboard and include aria-labels like "Copy schema for path user.address". zoe: Localization: keep copy short and avoid punctuation that complicates languages. I'll test German/Japanese lengths. maria: Example ARIA snippet I'll add to Figma notes: ```html
fetch_user() · 190ms
``` sam: LGTM. For aria-live, only announce once on finalization: "Tool result complete for fetch_user". Avoid streaming intermediate announcements. alex: I'll add keyboard e2e tests and accessibility checks. Also include focus-ring styling and visible focus indicators for high contrast themes. zoe: I'll provide alternate collapsed summary strings for i18n review. dinesh: Small perf note: limit the number of DOM nodes for deeply nested results; render-on-demand when breadcrumb is expanded. aria-bot: Action items: maria -> update Figma frames with ARIA notes; alex -> keyboard + e2e tests; zoe -> localization samples; dinesh -> render-on-demand plan; sam -> header copy variations. Ping thread when done.
